Class Lynis

java.lang.Object
marius.server.data.Lynis
@Entity public class Lynis extends Object
Represents the details of the Lynis configuration to share with the Python agent. Notes:
  • The auditor field is the name of the user who launches the scan.
  • The ip field is the IPv4 address of the agent where the configuration applies.
  • The loaded field is true when the skipped tests are loaded on the agent; false otherwise.
  • The listIdSkippedTest field contains a comma-separated list of IDs of the skipped tests. If null, it means that all rules must be checked.
